france.coverage: 245 higher-education institution entries plus 2026 Parcoursup undergraduate programme catalogue. Parcoursup records do not include tuition.

uk.coverage: Current Student-route sponsor register plus 32,533 eligible undergraduate course/location records for 2027–28 from HESA Discover Uni 2026; tuition is not included.

usa.coverage: IPEDS institutions (2024) plus U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard field/credential history (updated 2026-06-10). Programme rows reflect reported award cohorts, not a current admissions catalogue; no programme-level tuition is included.

canada.coverage: All post-secondary designated learning institution campus rows; source is a study-permit designation list, not a full course/fee catalogue.

germany.coverage: ROR education-type organization records (CC0); broad research-organizations data, not a complete legal list of state-recognized universities.

australia.coverage: CRICOS provider records and non-expired registered courses with published tuition (snapshot 2026-04-13).

ireland.coverage: HEA-listed publicly funded/core-funded higher education institutions; not all QQI-validated private providers.
